reachableVia: extractLabelEvidenceDetailed returns DetailedExtractionResult.debug, which is untruncated. The acquisition calls that function directly; it does not use the evaluation harness, whose CaseReport projection is what applied the caps.

capsExplicitlyNotApplied.MAX_SAMPLE_WORDS_PER_REGION: the 25-word sampleWords cap in eval-harness.ts is a CaseReport projection and is bypassed by reading extractionDebug directly
capsExplicitlyNotApplied.MAX_TEXT_LEN: the 120-character truncate() applied to CaseReport strings is likewise bypassed

opaqueItemId.value: the opaque item identifier; the schema field is NOT named caseId
opaqueItemId.note: MANIFEST-SOURCED. Not a field of RegionOcrResult.

role.derivedFrom: passKind plus triggerReasons; primary vs recovery
role.note: DERIVED by the acquisition. Not a field of RegionOcrResult.

sourceImageSha256.note: MANIFEST-SOURCED. Not a field of RegionOcrResult.

transformAndOrientation.source: PlannedOcrPass.transform (rotate, scale, originalWidth, originalHeight) and template.preprocessing

orderedWordsOnlyFingerprint.computedAs: sha256 of canonical JSON over the ordered word records ONLY
orderedWordsOnlyFingerprint.why: It covers words alone. The COMPLETE semantic pass fingerprint covers every RegionOcrResult field except timings. Two different digests must not share a name that suggests either could stand for the other. See determinism-rules.json.

originalWordOrder.note: array index in the emitted order, preserved exactly

originalGeometry.persistedWhenAbsent: OMITTED — the property is not written at all
originalGeometry.priorDefect: Amendment 4 said absent originalGeometry was 'recorded as null rather than omitted'. That is not an exact RegionOcrResult: a replay reading null sees a present-but-empty property where production had no property at all, and mapBoxToOriginalGeometry producing nothing is precisely the signal that the token was never mapped back to the original frame.
originalGeometry.replayRequirement: A replay must preserve omission, or explicitly decode it back to absence before selection. Passing null through is prohibited.

baselineGeometry.why: OcrWord carries no baseline. Exposing it would require changing the production OCR adapter, which this sprint forbids.

blockParagraphLineIdentifiers.why: The production adapter maps tesseract.js output to OcrWord, which carries no block, paragraph or line identifier. Exposing them would require a production change.
blockParagraphLineIdentifiers.mitigation: Reconstructed-line membership is captured separately in reconstructed-line-contract.json, which is the grouping the Brand path actually uses.

truncationAssertions: observed maximum words per pass and per case are recorded
observed maximum lines per case are recorded
the emitted word count per pass must equal the length of the debug pass word array
historicalNote: Amendment 1 described this evidence as reachable through runCaseArtifacts. That route is prohibited from Amendment 2 onward.
completeRegionOcrResultPersistence: Every RegionOcrResult field is persisted exactly; see region-ocr-result-replay-contract.json. The per-pass field list here is explanatory and is not a licence to persist a subset.

cropPixelSha256.priorClaim: Amendment 3 and earlier promised the SHA-256 of the preprocessed PNG buffer actually handed to the engine.
cropPixelSha256.whyWrong: runOcrPass (src/pipeline/extractor/regions.ts:610) builds that PNG inside a private preprocess() call, passes it to engine.recognizeWords, and returns only the 13-field RegionOcrResult. The buffer is never exposed on debug.
cropPixelSha256.notReplacedBy: a separately reconstructed crop. Re-running preprocessing outside production would be a SECOND implementation; hashing its output and calling it cropPixelSha256 would mislabel a different byte stream as the original.
cropPixelSha256.wouldRequire: a production instrumentation change, which this sprint forbids

warningsAndErrors.priorClaim: Amendment 3 and earlier listed a per-pass warnings/errors array.
warningsAndErrors.whyWrong: RegionOcrResult carries no warning or error field. runOcrPass reports failures by THROWING (PREPROCESSING_FAILED, OCR_PASS_FAILED, OCR_PASS_MAPPING_FAILED) through the optional diagnostics trace, which the acquisition does not pass. A thrown pass produces no pass record at all.
warningsAndErrors.replacedBy: item-level typed failure evidence; see itemLevelFailureEvidence

itemLevelFailureEvidence.sourceOfTruthForShape: the Result<DetailedExtractionResult, ExtractionError> returned by extractLabelEvidenceDetailed; ExtractionError is { code, message, issues } at src/pipeline/extractor/extractor.types.ts:57
itemLevelFailureEvidence.noInventedDebug: No partial debug object may be synthesised after an extractor failure. A failed item has no pass array, no lines and no candidates, and none may be fabricated.
itemLevelFailureEvidence.noSelectiveRetry: A failed item is never retried, in whole or in part.
itemLevelFailureEvidence.verdict: A case-level extraction failure produces the preregistered RUNTIME_FAILURE or INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE verdict per determinism-rules.json. It is never quietly dropped from the population.

derivedVersusTypeFields: Fields marked derived:true or manifest-sourced are computed by the acquisition or copied from the truth-free manifest. They are labelled as such so no reader mistakes them for properties of RegionOcrResult. The authoritative field list of RegionOcrResult is region-ocr-result-replay-contract.json.
